senses.gloss: m. (לָעַז) speaking a foreign tongue, esp. Greek.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 2:1:4">Y. Meg. II, beg. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>היתה כתובה כהלכתה הל׳ יוצא בה בלעז</he> if the Book of Esther was written according to law (in Hebrew), the Greek-speaking (reading from it) in Greek (translation) performs his duty.—Pl. <he>לְעוֹזוֹת</he>. Mish. ib. II, 1 <he>קירין אותה לל׳ בלעז והלוֹעֵז וכ׳</he> Y. ed. (Bab. a. Mish. <he>ללוֹעֲזוֹת</he>) it is read to those speaking a foreign tongue in their tongue, but the foreigner that heard it in Hebrew &c. Y. ib. IV, 75ᵃ bot. Tosef. ib. IV (III), 13 <he>בית הכנסת של ל׳</he> (Var. <he>לעזות</he>) in a synagogue of foreigners; a. e.
